integrity.proof_status: An explicit all-parameter graph/transport/duality proof is included; exhaustive checks are corroboration, not proof.
integrity.publication_priority: Best-knowledge literature comparison; not an assertion of absolute uniqueness or priority.
integrity.scientific_scope: Binary words, fixed weight, contiguous length-three cyclic rotations, any finite number of sequential steps, n at least 3.

limitations: Does not determine optimal code sizes, shortest-path multiplicities, or finite-radius ball volumes.
Does not cover nonbinary alphabets, windows longer than three, or circular indexing.
An exact diameter computation in unindexed earlier literature remains a priority risk.
title: Exact multiburst diameter for binary three-position cyclic permutations
